messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 HIGH ERROR RATE detected on /v1/generate (prod-us-east-1). 5xx spike at 14:08 UTC, p95 latency + dropped requests. Paging oncall (Alex Kim). See: https://internal.ops/runbooks/ingress-5xx

Alex Kim: I got the page, triaging now. initial observation: sudden spike in GPU OOMs on inference pool-03 causing backend 503s, likely some model variant hitting mem growth. Rolling my hotfix now (pinning traffic to stable-quantized variant).

Jonas Miller: logs look like KV-cache misses grew and memory climbed. snapshot from 14:06: 
```
pod/inference-03-7f9b kernel: out_of_memory: GPU0
2026-03-15T14:06:01Z error: model-loader exceeded mem budget
```

Alex Kim: mitigation step 1: scale down problematic replica set and route to pool-01. command: 
```bash
kubectl scale rs inference-rt-quant --replicas=0 -n prod
```
Doing that now. Will monitor 5m.

Priya Desai: Thanks Alex. Quick question for customer impact assessment: which customers were on pool-03 at the time? we should surface to CS if any SLA hits.

Alex Kim: pulling routing table now, looks like a handful of mid-market tenants (acct: acme, org: factly). No dedicated customers. Early metric: errors dropped to baseline after scale/route.

Evan Park: Nice mitigation. Can we capture the chain for the postmortem? I'd like timestamps, short mitigation log, root cause hypothesis, and action items. I'll own the PM follow-up doc if someone can schedule the postmortem sync.

Marisol Rios: I can book the postmortem slot. Q: how urgent are the action items? We should size them (S/M/L) and tie any larger work to Q2 roadmap if needed.

Jonas Miller: Root cause hypothesis: a model quantization regress introduced a mem leak under certain sequence-length distributions; combined with traffic burst -> OOMs. Repro steps attached: run synthetic with seq_len=2048 on quantized-1.2.

Alex Kim: Postmortem draft plan: 1) Timeline & impact 2) Root cause & repro 3) Mitigation steps 4) Action items + owners + sizing 5) Follow-ups for Q2 planning.

Priya Desai: For customer communications: I'll draft a brief note for CS indicating limited impact and actions taken. Assign to me: customer-notice (S).

Evan Park: Proposed action items (from rapid triage):
- A1: Reproduce memory leak and confirm fix for quantized-1.2 (owner: Jonas Miller, size: M, due: 2026-03-22)
- A2: Add runtime circuit-breaker to route off pods hitting >80% GPU mem within 60s (owner: Alex Kim, size: M, due: 2026-04-05)
- A3: Update autoscaler policy to consider seq_len P95 spike (owner: eng-sre team, size: L, due: 2026-04-30)
- A4: Postmortem write-up and customer message (owner: Priya Desai, size: S, due: 2026-03-19)
- A5: Add quantization regression tests to CI with high-seq workloads (owner: Jonas Miller + eng-ml, size: L, due: 2026-05-07)

Marisol Rios: I propose prioritization based on severity: A2 and A3 are P0/P1 infra remediations (reduce future customer impact) -> schedule as Q2 initiatives. A1 and A5 are engineering-investigation and CI hygiene -> link A1 immediate, A5 Q2. A4 is immediate.

Alex Kim: I'll open the incident ticket in JIRA and add the above A items with labels: incident-1767601234, severity=SEV2.

Priya Desai: Scheduling: Marisol, can you book a 60-min postmortem for Friday 15:00 UTC? I'll prepare the customer comms beforehand.

Marisol Rios: Booked: Postmortem sync — Fri 2026-03-19 15:00 UTC (calendar invite sent). Agenda in thread.

incident-bot: Note: oncall handoff scheduled. Next oncall is Jonas Miller at 17:00 UTC. Handoff message: 
"Jonas -- please take over escalation monitoring for 2h; Alex will continue remediation tickets."

Jonas Miller: ack. I'll keep an eye on metrics and follow up on A1 repro tomorrow.

Evan Park: Quick decision: mark A2 as priority to be in the Dedicated infra backlog and tag for quarterly planning. I'll sync with Eng PMs to reserve one sprint of capacity for the autoscaler changes.

Alex Kim: after follow-up checks: 5xxs returned to baseline, no customer-facing downtime detected, telemetry shows restored capacity. Closing immediate mitigation.

Priya Desai: I'll post the short customer note after the postmortem doc is ready, linking to the timeline and confirm no SLA credit required.

Marisol Rios: Action item owners, please add estimates in JIRA and set correct due dates. We'll review during the postmortem meeting and commit to Q2 planning for L-sized items. :spiral_calendar:

Alex Kim: Adding final note: add a runbook step to prefer pool-01 for quantized-1.x until A1 is resolved. I'll PR that now. :white_check_mark:

Jonas Miller: Thanks all — good coordination. Follow-ups captured in ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-INC-1767601234

incident-bot: Incident thread archived to /incidents/1767601234-post-incident-action-item-scope-and-quarter-plan.json
